item.title: Fire crews rescue dog from a nearly 30-foot deep well days after it went missing
item.description: 'Blue' disappeared on Thursday and, despite his family's best effort, remained missing until they found him at the bottom of a well. A special rescue team freed him on Sunday.

item.title: CPD: Woman fatally shot in Walnut Hills, police investigating
item.description: A woman died from a gunshot wound in Walnut Hills Sunday night after police responded to reports of a shooting on May Street.

item.title: 'What benefit does that have to our community?' | Wilmington residents' concerns over proposed data center
item.description: Wilmington residents held their third town hall meeting to voice concerns about a proposed Amazon data center that could be built near their community.
